blocks.text: THE HAGUE, Netherlands — Former Philippine president Rodrigo Duterte stands trial from Monday at the International Criminal Court in arguably the highest-profile case in the institution’s 24-year history. Duterte is the first Asian former head of state to appear at the ICC and his trial comes as the court faces unprecedented global pressure, including sweeping […]...
